name: IC 4441, SN 2021tkm field (Hubble)
blurb: IC 4441, a spiral galaxy and host of SN 2021tkm, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2021tkm-hubble
story: In 2021 the Type Ia supernova SN 2021tkm burst into view in a spiral arm of IC 4441. Hubble returned long after the blast to follow its slow late fading, testing how alike these exploding stars really are.

claims.text: SN 2021tkm is a Type Ia supernova in a spiral arm of the intermediate spiral galaxy IC 4441
SN 2021tkm was discovered by ASAS-SN on 2021 July 14
Hubble program 17191 observes Type Ia supernovae 600-1200 days after explosion to study their late-time decline and how uniform they are
